set.body:
Source: review finding in SshProcessRunner.scala:102-121.

Problem:
pipe-drain and exit-wait errors can escape as raw exceptions rather than SshProcessOutcome data, contradicting the library's routine-failure contract.

Acceptance:
- Represent stdin/stdout/stderr drain, wait, timeout, and teardown failures in a typed bounded SshProcessOutcome.
- Preserve partial stdout/stderr evidence and truncation metadata when safe.
- Reserve raised effects for programmer/runtime failures outside the declared process contract.
- Add deterministic failing-stream and failing-wait tests with no fiber leaks.
set.title: P6f.8: Keep SSH process failures inside the typed outcome algebra
